findings.fact: Gen Z and Boomers will adopt delicate animal-inspired aesthetics--think soft fawn freckles, butterfly-wing nails and fox-like outfits.
A wanderer-of-the-world or “paleontologist” look with khaki Bermuda shorts, utility shirts and pocket-laden streetwear will trend among Gen Z and Millennials.
Cool-toned “Ice-blue” style—glacier accessories, frosted makeup and icy cocktails—will spread across categories, led by Gen Z and Millennials.
Cabbage is set to dethrone cauliflower in 2026, driving dishes such as blistered-edge steaks, kimchi cocktails and crispy taco wraps.
Lace will appear everywhere—from bomber jackets and bandanas to crocheted phone cases—signalling a maximalist push for ornate textures.
A letter-writing renaissance will see Gen Z and Millennials turn snail mail into art with elaborate envelopes, stationery and stamps.
An ASMR-driven ‘gummy’ obsession will bring bendy phone cases, elastic cheek tints and rubberised nail art to the mainstream.
Parties will go vintage-theatre glam, featuring dramatic drapery, red roses and cabaret-style string quartets for opulent gatherings.
Home décor will fuse African and bohemian influences, with Nigerian textiles, Ethiopian art and natural-fibre accents gaining popularity.
Travel will take a mystical turn as Millennials and Boomers seek whimsical destinations such as mist-filled ruins and enchanting forests.
